semiconductor_relevance: High — Lux Industries provides on-site green hydrogen solutions specifically tailored for the semiconductor manufacturing industry.
summary: Lux Industries Ltd specializes in delivering Hydrogen-as-a-Service (HaaS) to the semiconductor sector, utilizing modular hydrogen liquefaction technology to produce ultra-high purity green hydrogen on demand. Their innovative systems reduce costs and emissions by eliminating the need for transport and enabling direct supply at the point of use.

regional_presence.United Kingdom: Lux Industries is based in Oxford and has secured funding for collaborative projects within the UK.
